## KEGG IDs

Three (KEGG, FELLA, Metscape) of the six analyses tools require KEGG IDs to function but have different
prerequisites. These three tools all work with the same data frame.

### Unique KEGG IDs

This data frame is used for the following analysis tools that rely on KEGG
IDs (KEGG, FELLA, Metscape). A separate column (KEGG) will be created with IDs that are unique. First,
the KEGG ML from the in-house database will be used. Second, the KEGG ID from
the mzCloud database will be added to the column if the ID was not already retrieved from the ML column.
If a KEGG ID has more than one entry, it will not be added again to the KEGG
column. For further information on the selection process have a look at the "Help Section" in the shiny app.

```{r create data frame with unique KEGG IDs, echo=FALSE, results='markup', tidy=TRUE}

resolve_KEGG <- function(df) {

  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      # --- KEGG sources ---
      KEGG_ML = as.character(safe_col(., "KEGG ML")),
      KEGG_ID = as.character(safe_col(., "KEGG ID")),

      # --- InChIKey sources ---
      InChI_ML  = safe_col(., "InChIKey ML"),
      InChI_db  = safe_col(., "InChIKey"),
      InChI_mzC = safe_col(., "InChIKey mzC"),

      # --- compound identity ---
      inchi = coalesce(InChI_ML, InChI_db, InChI_mzC),

      # --- flags ---
      is_KEGG_ML  = !is.na(KEGG_ML) & nzchar(KEGG_ML),
      is_InChI_ML = !is.na(InChI_ML) & nzchar(InChI_ML)
    )

  # global list of KEGG ML IDs (to prevent duplication)
  used_kegg_ml <- df2$KEGG_ML[df2$is_KEGG_ML] %>%
    unique()

  df2 %>%
    # group by compound (global behavior)
    group_by(inchi) %>%
    mutate(
      has_KEGG_ML  = any(is_KEGG_ML, na.rm = TRUE),
      has_InChI_ML = any(is_InChI_ML, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%

    # decision logic
    mutate(
      KEGG = case_when(
        # 1. KEGG ML always wins
        is_KEGG_ML ~ KEGG_ML,

        # 2. if KEGG ML exists in this compound → block fallback
        has_KEGG_ML ~ NA_character_,

        # 3. if no KEGG ML but InChI ML exists → block fallback
        !has_KEGG_ML & has_InChI_ML ~ NA_character_,

        # 4. prevent duplication of KEGG ML globally
        KEGG_ID %in% used_kegg_ml ~ NA_character_,

        # 5. otherwise allow fallback
        TRUE ~ KEGG_ID
      )
    ) %>%

    # --- cleanup ---
    filter(!is.na(KEGG), nzchar(KEGG)) %>%
    distinct(KEGG, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(KEGG) %>%

    select(
      KEGG,
      everything(),
      -KEGG_ML,
      -KEGG_ID,
      -InChI_ML,
      -InChI_db,
      -InChI_mzC,
      -inchi,
      -is_KEGG_ML,
      -is_InChI_ML,
      -has_KEGG_ML,
      -has_InChI_ML
    )
}

xlfile.KEGG.unique <- resolve_KEGG(xlfile.df)

head(xlfile.KEGG.unique)
```
